## Validation and compatibility

`generate.mjs:271-289,453-508` shares the positive-safe-integer PR rule between lookup and serialization. Numeric positive PRs survive unchanged; strings (including "42"), zero, negatives, fractions, booleans, objects and unsafe integers are dropped with a stop-specific warning. Actual fake-gh argv receipts contained only `pr view 7 --json` and `pr view 42 --json`; a nested valid PR under an invalid parent remained discoverable, and hostile flag strings never reached gh.

Three- and six-digit hex colours retain their case and value in the generator and page. All 5 colours and 8 PR references in the current structure pass these validators. Named colours, alpha hex forms and arbitrary CSS are intentionally outside the documented contract, not accidentally misparsed valid inputs. Nonempty invalid colours produce a line/value-specific warning, fall back deterministically, and do not rewrite the structure. The page uses a muted fallback for independently supplied invalid data.

`cleanData` runs before layout and recursively cleans nested stops. Independent probes preserved legitimate HTTPS links and rejected javascript, data, HTTP, protocol-relative and non-string links. The actual stop, line, crew and station card builders escaped hostile values, including quote-bearing attribute inputs. Six real keyboard-focus card paths in Chrome remained inert with hostile data supplied after generator validation: no injected image/script/SVG, no event attributes, no hostile PR row/link, no execution, and invalid paints became muted.
